detail: p3_ep13_script.md: Design a school bag like an engineer (Ch 3, p. 66 + Theme Closure, pp. 70-72). Part 1 A METAL Strap? Then We Designed a ZOO Home! (the test, 5 weights vs 9; a goat home; Basil's zoo map; why variety matters; 546 words, about 5:00-5:13). Five look-closers, two journeys (be a book in the bag, be the new strap), butterfly and frog, dare into EP14 (why does the Sun come back: Sun moves away, Earth turns, clouds). Dare wording in one block (section 3). With EP12 it covers pp. 59-72, so the classic 'Why That Material?' can leave the main playlist once EP13 is live. Questions for the teacher in section 11, item 21 (first: the printed order of the steps on p. 66). Nothing drawn, voiced or rendered.
